list.text: Can you inflict any damage on our Pokémon?
We use only Ghost-type Pokémon.
No Normal-type attack can harm them!
Not sure of your way?\nDefeat me if you want a hint!
Having trouble finding your way around?\nThe path is right before our eyes!
I spent the spring with my Pokémon.\nThen summer, autumn, and winter...
Then spring came again. We have lived together for a long time.

lines: EndSpeech: Vitórias e derrotas, eu conheço as duas.

list.text: Where did Pokémon come from?
I shall win!
The one who wants to win--will!
\f[morty]\bIt's good of you to have come.
\f[morty]\bHere in Ecruteak, Pokémon have long been revered.
\f[morty]\bIt's said that a rainbow-hued Pokémon will come down to appear before a truly powerful Trainer.
\f[morty]\bI believed that tale, so I have secretly trained here all my life.
\f[morty]\bAs a result, I can now see what others cannot.
\f[morty]\bI see a shadow of the person who will make the Pokémon appear.
\f[morty]\bI believe that person is me!
\f[morty]\bYou're going to help me reach that level!

lines: EndSpeech: Não sou bom o bastante ainda...\n Certo, essa Insígnia da Nevoa é sua.

then.text: \f[morty]\bI don't think our potential are so different. But you seem to have something more than that...
\f[morty]\bSo be it. This Badge is yours.
\PN received the Fog Badge from Morty!
\f[morty]\bBy having the Fog Badge, Pokémon up to Lv. 50, including traded Pokémon, will obey you.
\f[morty]\bAlso, your Pokémon will be authorized to use Surf.
\f[morty]\bHere is another thing...\nI want you to have this, too.
\f[morty]\bIt's Shadow Ball. It causes damage and may reduce Special Defense.Use it if it appeals to you.

list.text: \f[morty]\bI get it...

then.text: \f[morty]\bThe person the Kimono Girls were talking about must be you...

list.text: \f[morty]\bYou should be strong enough to go across the sea.
\f[morty]\bWhen you go west and then south, you'll reach Olivine City.
\f[morty]\bOr you can go east and reach Mahogany Town.\nWhich way you'll go?

then.text: \f[morty]\bDo you want to take photo to show to your mom?\nI don't lke taking photos, but will make an exception this time.

list.text: \f[morty]Morty: \bI was just talking about you...
\f[morty]\bThe legendary Pokémon did not choose me...
\f[morty]\bBut that does not mean that I have lost out on my future.
\f[morty]\bI will continue my training until I discover a new future for me.
\f[morty]\bSay, do you want to be part of my training?

then.text: \f[morty]\bYou may have something more than just strength...
\f[morty]\bThis is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Ghost-type moves to Z-Moves.

list.text: \f[morty]\bI get it...
\f[morty]\bThe legendary Pokémon did not choose me...
\f[morty]\bBut that does not mean that I have lost out on my future.
\f[morty]\bI will continue my training until I discover a new future for me.
Yo! Champ in the making!
The Trainers here use Ghost-type Pokémon at will.
A ghost is like a shade or a phantom...\nIt won't do any good to use physical strenght alone.
Whew, \PN.\nYou did great!
I was cowering in the corner out of pure terror!
